title: Extraction and model validation
scope: Evaluate sentence detection, taxonomy matching, title coding and assignment review separately. Agreement with model judges is not equivalent to worker or expert validation.
reproduction: Model documentation and validation resources; exact versions must accompany each application.

title: National occupational relatedness
scope: Inspect equal-length comparisons, origin and destination populations, and benchmark definitions. These results assess historical alignment, not placement effects.
reproduction: Released aggregate evidence; full upstream analysis needs its documented inputs.

title: Registered Nurses and Figure 1
scope: Use the worked example to understand the calculation, then render the public figure from its released aggregate workbook.
reproduction: Runnable public figure package; not reconstruction of private task profiles.

title: Alternative representations
scope: Distinguish task profiles, activity-linked skills/abilities and directly extracted skills. Do not generalize one comparison to all representations.
reproduction: Existing comparison outputs; direct SkillMatch analysis is a separate workflow.

title: Institutional demand profiles
scope: Construct a profile of advertised demand at the occupation or agency level, using a stated corpus and denominator.
reproduction: Worked examples in the earlier Evidence dashboard.

title: Military-to-civilian connections
scope: Separate title mappings, task evidence, documented correspondences and exploratory suggestions. Role descriptions are not individual skill assessments.
reproduction: Public-source demonstration with limited pathway review coverage.

title: Evidence-grounded task bundles
scope: Compare concept-led STEM selection, incident-supported activities and emerging-language taxonomy construction. A matching gap is a review candidate; incident membership is not an injury rate.
reproduction: Worked extensions with domain-specific evidence and review.

title: Choose a reproduction path
scope: Rendering a public figure, repeating downstream analysis from frozen outputs, and rerunning source extraction require different inputs.
reproduction: Public code does not remove data access restrictions.

title: Build with JAAT
scope: Reuse the extraction tools and record code, model and taxonomy versions. A common vocabulary supports local extensions without requiring identical aggregation rules.
reproduction: Open tools; source-data access is separate.

title: Earlier Evidence dashboard
scope: Explore existing agency/occupation profiles, AI measures and dynamic maps. These retain their own source periods, formulas and release records.
reproduction: Separate existing collection; not a replacement for the new relatedness comparison.

title: Workforce information and its uses
scope: Use occupational connections and demand profiles to investigate career pathways, recruitment pools and training needs. Keep task commonality distinct from credentials, licensing and other requirements.
reproduction: Occupational measures inform these investigations; they do not establish individual eligibility.
